select sp.project_type_name,
sum(case when sp.id not in (3,4,5) and sp.id in (${projectIds}) then 1 else 0 end) as totalCount
0 as totalCount
from sys_project sp where sp.del_flag = 0
and sp.province_code = #{provinceCode}
and sp.project_type_id = #{projectTypeId}
group by sp.project_type_id
select GROUP_CONCAT(project_name) from sys_project where del_flag = 0 and FIND_IN_SET(id,#{ids})
